title: Crashed Thargoid Scout #2
excerpt: A crashed Thargoid Scout can be found on Pleiades Sector LN-T c3-4 body 2 a, located at -60.2105, 41.1846 (in Live/4.0) or at -60.8799, 42.5728 (in Legacy/3.8). The crash site is surrounded by Thargoid Technology Samples, Thargoid Biological Matter, and Thargoid Resin. There is a data point to target with your SRV's data link scanner,…
